Name: Hawthorn Lane, Summer Light
Short description: A sunlit country lane runs past hawthorn in bloom and a field gate, with purple-blue mountains under a wide summer sky.
Description:
Late-afternoon light falls across a quiet country road, throwing long violet shadows over warm golden tarmac. Hawthorn froths white along the hedgerow, a farm gate stands open, and the mountains roll back in layers of lilac, blue and sunlit green. Loose, confident brushwork and a sky full of moving cloud catch the feeling of an Irish summer evening.

Short description: White cottages with blue roofs sit on a green headland above dark rocks and a silver Atlantic tide.
Description:
A row of white cottages with blue roofs perches on a bright green headland, looking out over a rocky shore. Streaks of dark rock and wet sand lead the eye toward a glittering sea and distant hills. The palette of blues, slate and white has the cool, clean light of the west coast after rain.

Name: Winter Farmhouse, Blue Shadows
Short description: A snow-covered farmhouse and fence line under a deep blue sky, with long cobalt shadows across the fields.
Description:
Fresh snow blankets a farmhouse, its outbuildings and the fields rolling away to a distant mountain. Cobalt and ultramarine shadows stretch across the drifts while touches of ochre grass break through. Bold, flat shapes and saturated blues turn a cold winter morning into something bright and graphic.

Name: Willow at the Water's Edge
Short description: A weeping willow leans over still water, glowing in yellow and green washes with deep indigo reflections.
Description:
A weeping willow trails its branches toward a riverbank, its reflection breaking up in the water below. Washes of lemon yellow and spring green meet deep indigo and blue, letting the white of the paper shine through as light. Painted wet-in-wet, it shows the transparency and immediacy that Edel loves in watercolour.
